arxiv-2104-08802.title: Electro-optical properties of excitons in Cu 2 O quantum wells: II continuum states
arxiv-2104-08802.creator: David Ziemkiewicz, Gerard Czajkowski, Karol Karpiński, Sylwia Zielińska-Raczyńska
arxiv-2104-08802.description: Abstract We present theoretically calculated the optical functions for Cu 2 O quantum well (QW) with Rydberg excitons in an external homogeneous electric field parallel to the QW planes for the energy region above the gap, suitable to observe the Franz-Keldysh (FK) oscillations.

arxiv-2209-06855.title: Data Lifecycle Management in Evolving Input Distributions for Learning-based Aerospace Applications
arxiv-2209-06855.creator: Somrita Banerjee, Apoorva Sharma, Edward Schmerling, Max Spolaor, Michael Nemerouf, Marco Pavone
arxiv-2209-06855.description: Abstract As input distributions evolve over a mission lifetime, maintaining performance of learning-based models becomes challenging. This paper presents a framework to incrementally retrain a model by selecting a subset of test inputs to label, which allows the model to adapt to changing input distributions.

arxiv-2210-10623.title: Mythos in Fundamental Physics
arxiv-2210-10623.creator: Nirmal Raj
arxiv-2210-10623.description:
A 2022 arXiv research paper by Nirmal Raj. Introduction

There must be something about the myths of ancient Greece that stirs physicists, which must be why they draw upon them heavily for naming experiments, machines, codes, and phenomena. The practice is particularly ubiquitous in fundamental physics, perhaps because one of the chief functions of Greek mythology parallels the chief goal of the field: to address the mysteries of Nature.

arxiv-2406-09385.title: Towards Vision-Language Geo-Foundation Model: A Survey Thanks: Yue Zhou is with S-Lab, Nanyang Technological University. Yiping Ke is with School of Computer Science and Engineering, Nanyang Technological University. Litong Feng, Wayne Zhang are with SenseTime Research. Xue Jiang is with Department
arxiv-2406-09385.creator: Yue Zhou, Litong Feng, Yiping Ke, Xue Jiang, Junchi Yan
arxiv-2406-09385.description: Abstract Vision-Language Foundation Models (VLFMs) have made remarkable progress on various multimodal tasks, such as image captioning, image-text retrieval, visual question answering, and visual grounding. However, most methods rely on training with general image datasets, and the lack of geospatial data leads to poor performance on earth observation.

arxiv-2502-08417.title: Handwritten Text Recognition: A Survey
arxiv-2502-08417.creator: Carlos Garrido-Munoz, Antonio Rios-Vila, Jorge Calvo-Zaragoza
arxiv-2502-08417.description: Abstract Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) has become an essential field within pattern recognition and machine learning, with applications spanning historical document preservation to modern data entry and accessibility solutions. The complexity of HTR lies in the high variability of handwriting, which makes it challenging to develop robust recognition systems.

pmc-11592608.title: Ultrasound Imaging Comparison of Crural Fascia Thickness and Muscle Stiffness in Stroke Patients with Spasticity
pmc-11592608.creator: Jongwon Choi, Yerim Do, Haneul Lee, Evangelos Terpos
pmc-11592608.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background/Objective: Spasticity following stroke causes structural changes in the muscles and fascia, affecting the mobility and functional recovery of patients. Understanding these structural changes is critical to optimizing the rehabilitation strategies for patients. Therefore, in this study, we aimed to investigate the differences in crural and epimysial fascia thickness and muscle stiffness in the affected and unaffected lower limbs of chronic stroke patients with spasticity.

pmc-11596785.title: The Microbiota of the Outer Gut Mucus Layer of the Migrating Northeast Arctic Cod (Gadus morhua) as Determined by Shotgun DNA Sequencing
pmc-11596785.creator: Typhaine Le Doujet, Peik Haugen, Lifeng Zhu
pmc-11596785.description: Animals form functional units with their microbial communities, termed metaorganisms. Despite extensive research on some model animals, microbial diversity in many species remains unexplored. Here, we describe the taxonomic profile of the microbes from the outer gut mucus layer from the Northeast Arctic cod using a shotgun DNA sequencing approach.

pmc-12608003.title: Hypericin Photodynamic Therapy Induces Cytotoxicity and Modulates Cytokine Secretion in MCF-7 Breast Cancer Cells
pmc-12608003.creator: Magdalena Czarnecka-Czapczyńska, Zenon Czuba, David Aebisher, Wiktoria Mytych, Jakub Fiegler-Rudol, Rafał Wiench, Aleksandra Kawczyk-Krupka
pmc-12608003.description: Background/Aim: Photodynamic therapy uses a photosensitizer and light to generate reactive oxygen species that kill tumor cells and can shift inflammatory signaling. Hypericin is a potent photosensitizer, but its immunomodulatory impact in breast cancer needs clarification. We evaluated the phototoxic and cytokine-modulating effects of hypericin-mediated photodynamic therapy in MCF-7 human breast adenocarcinoma cells.

pmc-13094892.title: Pottery art therapy for chronic schizophrenia: Impact on negative symptoms, quality of life, and social skills in a randomized controlled trial
pmc-13094892.creator: R Praveena, S Natarajan, DC Mathangi, P Thamilselvan
pmc-13094892.description: BACKGROUND:Schizophrenia is a debilitating mental health condition affecting approximately 1% of the global population. Negative symptoms, experienced by 50–90% of individuals, significantly impact quality of life and social skills. Current treatments often fall short in addressing these symptoms. Pottery art therapy, a creative and non-pharmacological approach, is investigated as an adjunctive treatment for chronic schizophrenia.

pmc-13104533.title: A tool based on objective data to identify patients at elevated risk of hospital-onset Staphylococcus aureus bacteremia: a nested case–control study
pmc-13104533.creator: Richard Silvera, Minji Jeon, Avi Ma’ayan, Judith Aberg, Bernard Camins, Stephanie H Factor
pmc-13104533.description: Objective:Identify patients at increased risk of hospital-onset Staphylococcus aureus (SA) bacteremia based on objective and routinely collected data on presentation to the emergency room (ER).Design:Nested case–control study.Setting:A large, inner city, tertiary care center between January 1, 2011 and August 31, 2020.Participants:375 cases and 2,248 matched controls.

pmc-13266020.title: Targeting cyclic di-AMP signaling through diadenylate cyclase inhibition reduces methicillin resistance in clinical MRSA isolates
pmc-13266020.creator: Niti Kumari, Itishree Jali, Priyanka Garg, Repally Ayanna, Vinay Bhaskar, Vasundhra Bhandari, Shailesh Sharma, Bappaditya Dey
pmc-13266020.description: Highlights•Cyclic-di-AMP is a non-canonical driver of methicillin resistance in MRSA.•Sub-MIC methicillin and biofilms elevate c-di-AMP via DacA upregulation.•Elevated c-di-AMP activates STING and skews macrophage responses.•FDA approved drugs tropinone and eucalyptol identified as DacA inhibitors.•DacA inhibition restores β-lactam susceptibility in MRSA.

pmc-13402697.title: Prediction of unerupted canines and premolars widths in an Emirati population: development and validation of regression and machine learning models
pmc-13402697.creator: Nour Alnusairat, Ali I Ibrahim, Hasna Alsaeed, Widad Nsairat, Amar H Khamis, Nameer Al-Taai
pmc-13402697.description: This study aimed to develop a more accurate model for predicting the widths of unerupted canines and premolars in Emirati children, using deep learning and machine learning techniques. Dental models of 380 Emirati individuals aged 15–30 years were collected. The mesiodistal widths of permanent teeth were measured with a standardized orthodontic digital caliper.
